INSCRYPTION-CREATURE_POWER.title: Creature
INSCRYPTION-CREATURE_POWER.description: Takes the hits of the enemy in its lane. At the end of your turn, strikes that enemy (or the first enemy if its lane is empty).

INSCRYPTION-BONES_POWER.title: Bones
INSCRYPTION-BONES_POWER.description: Gained whenever one of your creatures dies.
INSCRYPTION-TOTEM_POWER.title: Totems
INSCRYPTION-TOTEM_POWER.description: Totems stand this combat. Each gives its sigil to your creatures of its tribe.
